pairs.english: The day after returning to school, Tavi spent the entire class without borrowing properties, responsible only for changing water.
pairs.hanzi: 回校第二天，塔维整整一堂课没碰借性，只负责换水。

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī ràng tā hé tèlún huàn le wèizhì . tā yuánlái zuò de dìfāng yíng zhe chuāng , yè zhù hòumiàn yǒu yìtiáo liàngguāng , shāo yì piāntóu jiù kànbùqīng biānyuán .
pairs.english: Bai had him and Teren switch places. His old seat faced the window; a strip of glare behind the liquid columns blurred their edges when he tilted his head even slightly.
pairs.hanzi: 柏老师让他和特伦换了位置。他原来坐的地方迎着窗，液柱后面有一条亮光，稍一偏头就看不清边缘。

pairs.target: tèlún zuò guòqù , búdào bàn kè biàn zhòuqǐ méi , shēnshǒu ná zhǐ dǎngguāng . tǎ wéi zhè cái zhīdào , zìjǐ xiānqián jìde hūgāohūdī , yǒu yíbùfen jìngshì yǎnjīng hé zuòwèi de wèntí .
pairs.english: Within a few minutes of sitting there, Teren frowned and reached for paper to shade the glare. Only then did Tavi realize some of his fluctuating records were actually a problem of his eyes and seat.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦坐过去，不到半刻便皱起眉，伸手拿纸挡光。塔维这才知道，自己先前记得忽高忽低，有一部分竟是眼睛和座位的问题。

pairs.target: " zhèhuí kěyǐ guài chuāng . " tèlún shuō , " bùnéng yìzhí guài . " tǎ wéi bǎ zuìhòu yídài shuǐ fàngwěn , zài zhǐ shàng huà le gè xiǎochuāng , pángbiān jì zhe yào dǎng .
pairs.english: “You can blame the window this time,” Teren said. “Not forever.” Tavi steadied the last water bag and drew a little window on his paper, noting beside it: shade it.
pairs.hanzi:
“这回可以怪窗。”特伦说，“不能一直怪。”
塔维把最后一袋水放稳，在纸上画了个小窗，旁边记着要挡。

pairs.target: tā méi huàdiào qiánmiàn de huài jìlù . děng pǔtōng shēngwēn de jǐlún zuò wán , liǎng rén huàn zhe hé le yíbiàn , cái jiāogěi lǎoshī . yòu guò yìtiān , tā huòzhǔn zuò dìèrcì chángshì .
pairs.english: He didn't cross out the earlier bad records. After completing the ordinary warming rounds, they checked each other's work before handing it in. Another day later, he was allowed a second attempt.
pairs.hanzi:
他没划掉前面的坏记录。等普通升温的几轮做完，两人换着核了一遍，才交给老师。
又过一天，他获准做第二次尝试。

pairs.target: tóngtiáo réng shì jīngguò héduì de tóng cái pèiduì , zhěngjiàn tǐjī xiāngděng . jīntiān shuǐ gèng wēnhé , néng yòng de biànhuà fúdù yě bèi lǎoshī shōu dé gèng xiǎo .
pairs.english: The rods remained a checked pair of the same material, equal in whole volume. Today's water was milder, and the teacher had reduced the permitted range of change still further.
pairs.hanzi: 铜条仍是经过核对的同材配对，整件体积相等。今天水更温和，能用的变化幅度也被老师收得更小。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān wèn shìbushì pà tā shībài . bǎi lǎoshī shuō , shì pà tā yí jiàodé yǒu xīwàng , jiù jí zhe zhuī xià yìdiǎn . tā méiyǒu fǎnbó , shǒu fàngshàngqù zhīqián , quèshí yǐ zài xiǎng zhèhuí ruò chéng le néng bunéng zài zuò yícì .
pairs.english: Tavi asked first whether she feared he'd fail. Bai said she feared he'd see hope and rush to chase a little more. He didn't argue; before touching it, he had indeed been wondering whether success would let him try again.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维先问是不是怕他失败。柏老师说，是怕他一觉得有希望，就急着追下一点。
他没有反驳，手放上去之前，确实已在想这回若成了能不能再做一次。

pairs.target: wēnshuǐ cáo hé lěngshuǐ dài zhào xiānqián de yàngzi fàng hǎo , mù zhào dǎngzhù rè duān , zhǎngxīn zhī pèng zhōngjiān de duǎn duàn .
pairs.english: The warm-water baths and cool water bags were set up as before, wooden guards covering the warm ends, palms touching only the short central patches.
pairs.hanzi: 温水槽和冷水袋照先前的样子放好，木罩挡住热端，掌心只碰中间的短段。

pairs.target: xiān liáng bù shīshù shí de biànhuà , zài zhòngzhì shuǐwēn ; tèlún bàoshù , lǎoshī lìng kàn liǎngbiān , tǎ wéi búyòng zhuǎntóu .
pairs.english: First came measurements without casting, then a water-temperature reset; Teren called the readings, the teacher separately watched both sides, and Tavi didn't need to turn his head.
pairs.hanzi: 先量不施术时的变化，再重置水温；特伦报数，老师另看两边，塔维不用转头。

pairs.target: tā yì kāishǐ réng xiǎngxiàng tiě jiàn nàzhǒng sōngjǐn , shúxī de gǎnjué gāng màotóu , jiù zìjǐ tíngzhù . nà búshì zhèhuí yào zhǎo de dōngxī .
pairs.english: At first he still imagined the give of iron; as the familiar feeling appeared, he stopped himself. That wasn't what he was seeking this time.
pairs.hanzi: 他一开始仍想象铁件那种松紧，熟悉的感觉刚冒头，就自己停住。那不是这回要找的东西。

pairs.target: tā zhēng zhuóyǎn , kànjiàn tóngtiáo shàng yǒu yídào cābúdiào de xì hén , shùnzhe hén wǎng wài , shuǐcáo jiù zài bùyuǎnchù , wēn yì běnlái jiù huì cóng nàlǐ wǎng lìngyìduān zǒu . tā búbì bǎ tā cóng zhǎng xīnlǐ jǐchūlái .
pairs.english: Eyes open, he saw a fine indelible scratch on the rod. Following it outward, the bath lay close by; warmth would naturally travel from there toward the other end. He didn't need to squeeze it from his palms.
pairs.hanzi:
他睁着眼，看见铜条上有一道擦不掉的细痕，顺着痕往外，水槽就在不远处，温意本来就会从那里往另一端走。
他不必把它从掌心里挤出来。

pairs.target: zhè jù huà tā zài dìyītáng yǐjīng tīng guò , kě zhídào zhè yíkè , tā cái fājué zìjǐ xiānqián yìzhí bǎ gēbo yě bēngzhe , xiàng zài tì shuǐ jiā yìbǎ jìn .
pairs.english: He had heard that in the first class, but only now realized he'd been tensing his arms too, as if helping the water along.
pairs.hanzi: 这句话他在第一堂已经听过，可直到这一刻，他才发觉自己先前一直把胳膊也绷着，像在替水加一把劲。

pairs.target: tā sōngkāi jiān , réng liúzhù liǎngchù jiēchù , bú qù xiǎng shuǐdài xiànzài gāi yǒu duō rè , zhī shì zhe biànchū nà yílù tōngguò shí de bùtóng .
pairs.english: He relaxed his shoulders, keeping both contacts, without imagining how hot the bags ought to be now, only trying to distinguish the difference in passage along that route.
pairs.hanzi: 他松开肩，仍留住两处接触，不去想水袋现在该有多热，只试着辨出那一路通过时的不同。

pairs.target: qǐchū méiyǒu shénme . suíhòu zuǒzhǎng xiàmiàn sìhū yǒu yìxiǎo duàn lù biànzhǎi , gǎnjué qīng dé yì zǒushén jiù huì diū . tā chàdiǎn zhuīguòqù , tīngjiàn lǎoshī shuō bǎochí , biàn yìngshēngshēng tíng zài yuánchù .
pairs.english: At first there was nothing. Then a short stretch beneath his left palm seemed to narrow, so faint that distraction would lose it. He almost chased it, but hearing the teacher say hold, forced himself to stay where he was.
pairs.hanzi: 起初没有什么。随后左掌下面似乎有一小段路变窄，感觉轻得一走神就会丢。他差点追过去，听见老师说保持，便硬生生停在原处。

pairs.target: jǐcì bàoshù hòu , tā ràng tā shōuhuí . tā zhào cìxù jiéshù , liǎngshǒu réng tiēzhe , děng lǎoshī jiǎnchá guò cái sōngkāi .
pairs.english: After several readings, she had him withdraw. He ended in order, both hands still touching, releasing only after the teacher checked.
pairs.hanzi:
几次报数后，她让他收回。
他照次序结束，两手仍贴着，等老师检查过才松开。

pairs.target: zhǎngxīn méiyǒu fāhóng , shuǐdài yě méiyǒu hūrán lěng xiàqù . yǐjīng guòqù de rè hái zài , qǔxiāo de zhǐshì nà yìdiǎn chuándì kuàimàn de gǎibiàn .
pairs.english: His palms weren't red, nor did the water bags suddenly cool. Heat already transferred remained; only that slight change in the speed of transfer was canceled.
pairs.hanzi: 掌心没有发红，水袋也没有忽然冷下去。已经过去的热还在，取消的只是那一点传递快慢的改变。

pairs.target: tèlún méi shuō chéng le , bǎ zhǐ dìgěi lǎoshī , zìjǐ wǎnghòu kào . bǎi lǎoshī náchū xiānqián de kòngbái jìlù , yìzǔzǔ bǐ , zài àn zhè tào qìjù de huànsuàn hé lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: Teren didn't announce success; he handed the sheet to the teacher and leaned back. Bai took out the earlier baseline records, comparing each set, then checking the other side using the apparatus's conversion.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦没说成了，把纸递给老师，自己往后靠。柏老师拿出先前的空白记录，一组组比，再按这套器具的换算核另一边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànbùdǒng tā quánbù de suànfǎ , què kàndédǒng nà liǎngtiáoxiàn bìng búshì jiǎndān dì yìgāoyìdī jiù suànshù .
pairs.english: Tavi couldn't follow all her calculations, but understood that simply having one line higher and one lower wasn't enough.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看不懂她全部的算法，却看得懂那两条线并不是简单地一高一低就算数。

alignment.english: one line higher and one lower

pairs.target: " zhè yìhuí néng quèrèn . " tā zhōngyú shuō , " hěnxiǎo , jiēchù shí yǒu . xiān bié zhàn qǐlái qìngzhù , shuǐ hái méi zhòngzhì . " tǎ wéi méi zhàn qǐlái , xīgài dǎo zhuàng le yíxià zhuō dǐ .
pairs.english: “This time it's confirmed,” she finally said. “Very small, during contact. Don't get up to celebrate yet; the water hasn't been reset.” Tavi didn't stand, but did knock his knee against the table's underside.
pairs.hanzi:
“这一回能确认。”她终于说，“很小，接触时有。先别站起来庆祝，水还没重置。”
塔维没站起来，膝盖倒撞了一下桌底。

pairs.target: huànshuǐ zài cè , pǔtōng chuánrè de sùdù huídào yuánxiān fànwéi . tā dīng zhe zhǐ , děng le hǎo yíhuìer , zhídào tèlún ná chǐ qiāo tā shǒubiān , shuō jì wán le , cái kěn chéngrèn nà shì zhēnde .
pairs.english: After changing water and measuring again, ordinary heat-transfer rates returned to their previous range. He stared at the paper for quite a while, only accepting it was real when Teren tapped a ruler beside his hand and said the recording was done.
pairs.hanzi: 换水再测，普通传热的速度回到原先范围。他盯着纸，等了好一会儿，直到特伦拿尺敲他手边，说记完了，才肯承认那是真的。

pairs.target: shōu qìjù shí , tā rěnbúzhù wèn xià yícì néng bunéng huànchéng tiě , kànkàn shìbushì yě néng zhèyàng . bǎi lǎoshī bǎ tóngtiáo suǒ jìn hélǐ , shuō cáiliào hé fúdù dōu yào chóngxīn hé , jīntiān zhèdiǎn běnshì zhī liúzài jīntiān zhè tào zhuāngzhì lǐ . xiàcì xiān liàn chóngfù , bú huàn xīn dōngxī .
pairs.english: Putting the apparatus away, he couldn't help asking whether they could use iron next time and see if it worked too. Bai locked the rods in their box: materials and ranges would need fresh checks; today's skill belonged only to today's setup. Next time, practice repetition before trying something new.
pairs.hanzi: 收器具时，他忍不住问下一次能不能换成铁，看看是不是也能这样。柏老师把铜条锁进盒里，说材料和幅度都要重新核，今天这点本事只留在今天这套装置里。下次先练重复，不换新东西。

pairs.target: chūmén hòu , tèlún dìgěi tā yìxiǎo jié shéng . mǐlā yǐ jiào guò jiéfǎ , shéng shì wèn guò cái jiè de , dé zài zhōumò hái . tǎ wéi shì zhe zhā , jié tóu yòu fāncuò le .
pairs.english: Outside, Teren gave him a short length of rope. Mira had taught the knot; he had asked before borrowing the rope, due back at the weekend. Tavi tried tying it and turned the end the wrong way again.
pairs.hanzi: 出门后，特伦递给他一小截绳。米拉已教过结法，绳是问过才借的，得在周末还。塔维试着扎，结头又翻错了。

pairs.target: tèlún zhècì shuō dé hěn qīngchǔ , jiào tā bǎ duǎn tóu cóng xiàmiàn rào . " mén zhóu nàge , nǐ jiù bùnéng yě zhèyàng jiǎng ? " tǎ wéi wèn . " wǒ dǎo xiǎng . "
pairs.english: This time Teren explained clearly: loop the short end underneath. “Couldn't you explain that hinge thing this way too?” Tavi asked. “I wish I could.”
pairs.hanzi:
特伦这次说得很清楚，叫他把短头从下面绕。
“门轴那个，你就不能也这样讲？”塔维问。
“我倒想。”

pairs.target: zǒu dào shítáng ménkǒu , tǎ wéi cái juéde lèi , xiàng dīng zhe xìzì dú le hěn jiǔ , yǎnjīng hái xiǎng wǎng yìdiǎn shàng jù . tā bǎ shéng shōu jìn kǒudài , méiyǒu zài shì .
pairs.english: At the dining hall entrance, Tavi finally felt tired, as if he had spent ages reading tiny print, his eyes still trying to focus on one point. He pocketed the rope without trying again.
pairs.hanzi: 走到食堂门口，塔维才觉得累，像盯着细字读了很久，眼睛还想往一点上聚。他把绳收进口袋，没有再试。

pairs.target: tèlún xiān qù zhàn zuò , tā zài ménwài zhàn le yíhuìer , rèn lǐmiàn chāochaonàonào de shēngyīn mànmàn sànkāi , zuìhòu cái gēnjìnqù .
pairs.english: Teren went to find seats. Tavi stood outside a moment, letting the noisy voices within slowly spread apart, then followed him in.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦先去占座，他在门外站了一会儿，任里面吵吵闹闹的声音慢慢散开，最后才跟进去。
